CustomField.label: Other Language Name
CustomField.description: ★R8 SEIM_PERSON.OTHER_LANG_NAME. The person's name in their own script, held beside the Latin one rather than instead of it — a guest list printed for a regional event needs both. Not part of Unique_Key__c: the same person may appear with this column filled in one file and empty in another, and making identity depend on it would split them into two attendees.
